Meet your guide

Ting Lott, RN brings 17 years of nursing in psychiatric and crisis care — serving as a Crisis and Navigation RN — to every lesson in this journey. Before nursing, he spent 5 years as an elementary school teacher, and that teacher's heart still shapes how he guides: patiently, clearly, and one step at a time.

His greatest strength has always been understanding people in their hardest moments — when the mind is racing and nothing seems to calm it down but a gentle voice and time. Sacred Cycles Renewal carries that same calm into your own home: sincere words, quiet rhythms, and space to rest.

Sacred Cycles Renewal is part of ARTISY / T. Lott Creative — nurse-designed wellness courses, books, and music for the whole family.

Questions, answered gently

Is this faith-based?

Yes — Sacred Cycles Renewal is written with comfort, faith, and encouragement at its heart, with reflection and prayer prompts woven through the lessons. Take it in the way that fits you; every prompt is an invitation, never a requirement.

Is this medical advice?

No. This journey is encouragement and wellness support and education — it is not medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Please talk with a licensed professional about medical or mental-health concerns. If you are in crisis, call or text 988 (Suicide and Crisis Lifeline, US) any time.

What does it cost?

$14.99, one time. There is no subscription — pay once and the journey is yours to keep and revisit. A larger Complete Journey bundle ($97) opens November 3, 2026, but nothing about today's journey depends on it.

Is there a free way to start?

Yes, two of them. Take the free renewal quiz to find your personalized path, and join the free Sacred Cycle Renewal community on Whop — both are free, no purchase needed.

How do I take the journey?

Checkout is through Whop, and the 30 lessons are delivered there for you to work through across eight weeks — at your own pace, in your own time. A rhythm, not a race.

Your next season can feel different.

You don't need more pressure — you need a rhythm. Sacred Cycles Renewal is 30 gentle lessons, eight quiet weeks, and a guide who understands hard seasons.
